mentions.name: Waywo
mentions.description: Semantic search engine for "What are you working on?" threads, built on Redis 8 features such as the vector set data structure. It helps users quickly digest hundreds of project descriptions, explore similar projects, deduplicate projects across previous threads, and visualize a graph of all projects. Being developed for the Redis Hackathon on DEV.to.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Waywo, a semantic search engine for "What are you working on?" threads powered by new features in Redis 8 like the vector set data structure for semantic search.
